Why WH-1000XM5

Engineered for Perfection

Every detail of the WH-1000XM5 has been refined to deliver an unmatched listening experience.

Flagship ANC

8-Mic Array ANC

Industry-Leading Noise Cancellation

8 microphones paired with dual noise-canceling chips — QN1 HD + V1 — detect and eliminate ambient noise across all frequencies in real time.

Ultra Endurance

30-Hour Battery

All-Day, All-Night Listening

30 hours with ANC on, 40 hours without. Quick Charge gives you 3 hours of playback from just 3 minutes of charging.

Hi-Res Audio

LDAC Hi-Res Audio

Studio-Quality Wireless Sound

LDAC codec transmits 3× more data than standard Bluetooth. Pair with DSEE Extreme AI to upscale compressed audio to near Hi-Res quality.

AI Powered

DSEE Extreme AI

AI Audio Enhancement

Machine learning analyzes the music genre and instruments in real time, restoring lost details from compressed streaming audio sources.

Multipoint

Multipoint Connect

Two Devices, Zero Friction

Stay connected to two Bluetooth devices simultaneously. Seamlessly switch audio between your phone, laptop, or tablet without re-pairing.

Smart Feature

Speak-to-Chat

Intelligent Auto-Pause

Start speaking and the headphones automatically pause your music and activate ambient sound mode so you can have a conversation — hands free.
